pages.name: Something Shiny
pages.description: An oval object lies among the lazy fish. You could reach it by hand or try to lift it with a long branch.

options.description: Put your hand in the water
Lift the find with a branch

pages.name: Quick Teeth
pages.description: One fish proves much bolder than the others. It bites your finger, and the find disappears beneath the fins again.

scenePatch.description: The fish circle above the shiny object and clearly have no intention of giving it up.

pages.name: Cameo
pages.description: The branch hooks a small antique cameo. The fish watch it go with disapproving looks.

scenePatch.description: Only pebbles remain on the bottom. The fish swim peacefully again.

pages.name: Quiet Water
pages.description: You decide to leave everything alone. The shiny object remains a mystery.
